# 2. Normality Check of Variables

## i. Raw Variables

Now continuous variables must be checked for Normality by Shapiro-Wilk's method and skewness.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(fBasics)

# Create loop function
run_normality_tests <- function(dat) {

  # Identify numeric variables
  numeric_vars <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    names()

  # Initialize results data frame
  normality_results <- data.frame(
    Variable  = numeric_vars,
    Normality = NA_character_,
    Skewness  = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Loop over numeric variables
  for (i in seq_along(numeric_vars)) {

    var_data <- dat[[numeric_vars[i]]]

    # Skip non-numeric just in case
    if (!is.numeric(var_data)) {
      normality_results$Normality[i] <- "Not numeric"
      normality_results$Skewness[i]  <- NA
      next
    }

    # Shapiro–Wilk test (with error handling)
    test_result <- tryCatch(
      normalTest(var_data, method = "sw"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(test_result)) {
      normality_results$Normality[i] <-
        ifelse(test_result@test$p.value > 0.05, "Pass", "Fail")
    } else {
      normality_results$Normality[i] <- "Error"
    }

    # Skewness
    normality_results$Skewness[i] <- skewness(var_data)
  }

  return(normality_results)
}

# Run function
normality_results_ha10_cs <- run_normality_tests(ha10_cs)
normality_results_ha10_os <- run_normality_tests(ha10_os)
normality_results_ha80_cs <- run_normality_tests(ha80_cs)

# Inspect results
head(normality_results_ha10_cs)
head(normality_results_ha10_os)
head(normality_results_ha80_cs)
```

## ii. Log-Transformed Variables

Now we'll perform the same functions on the log-transformed variables (except pH since it's already log-transformed). We'll add a +1 constant to variables since log-transformations cannot be performed on 0 values.

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Exclude the following variables from being log-transformed
exclude_vars <- c(
  "pH",
  "Relative_elevation_m",
  "Dist_from_EFPC_km",
  "Drainage_area_km2",
  "Developed_lulc"
)

# Helper function for Normality and skewness checks
run_log_normality_tests <- function(dat, exclude_vars) {

  # Identify numeric variables eligible for log transform
  log_vars <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(exclude_vars)) %>%
    names()

  # Initialize results data frame
  normality_results <- data.frame(
    Variable  = log_vars,
    Normality = NA_character_,
    Skewness  = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Loop over variables
  for (i in seq_along(log_vars)) {

    var_data <- dat[[log_vars[i]]]

    # Log10 transform safely
    log_data <- ifelse(var_data > 0, log10(var_data), NA_real_)

    # Remove NAs before testing
    log_data <- log_data[!is.na(log_data)]

    # If too few observations, skip
    if (length(log_data) < 3) {
      normality_results$Normality[i] <- "Too few values"
      normality_results$Skewness[i]  <- NA
      next
    }

    # Shapiro–Wilk test
    test_result <- tryCatch(
      normalTest(log_data, method = "sw"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(test_result)) {
      normality_results$Normality[i] <-
        ifelse(test_result@test$p.value > 0.05, "Pass", "Fail")
    } else {
      normality_results$Normality[i] <- "Error"
    }

    # Skewness on log-transformed data
    normality_results$Skewness[i] <- skewness(log_data)
  }

  return(normality_results)
}

# Run
log_normality_results_ha10_cs <- run_log_normality_tests(ha10_cs, exclude_vars)
log_normality_results_ha10_os <- run_log_normality_tests(ha10_os, exclude_vars)
log_normality_results_ha80_cs <- run_log_normality_tests(ha80_cs, exclude_vars)

# Check
head(log_normality_results_ha10_cs)
head(log_normality_results_ha10_os)
head(log_normality_results_ha80_cs)
```

Save log-transformed variables into dataset objects

```{r}
# Helper function
add_log_variables <- function(dat, exclude_vars) {

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        .cols = where(is.numeric) &
          !any_of(exclude_vars) &
          !starts_with("log_"),      # <-- prevents re-logging
        .fns  = ~ ifelse(.x > 0, log10(.x), NA_real_),
        .names = "log_{.col}"
      )
    )
}

# Run
ha10_cs <- add_log_variables(ha10_cs, exclude_vars)
ha10_os <- add_log_variables(ha10_os, exclude_vars)
ha80_cs <- add_log_variables(ha80_cs, exclude_vars)

# Check
names(ha10_cs)[grepl("^log_", names(ha10_cs))]
```

# 3. Summary Statistics

We'll calculate summary statistics for all numeric variables across all sites.

```{r}
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Mode function
get_mode <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# Summary function for ONE dataset
summarize_numeric <- function(dat) {

  numeric_vars <- names(dat)[sapply(dat, is.numeric)]

  map_dfr(numeric_vars, function(colname) {
    vec <- dat[[colname]]
    n_non_na <- sum(!is.na(vec))

    tibble(
      variable = colname,
      mean     = mean(vec, na.rm = TRUE),
      median   = median(vec, na.rm = TRUE),
      mode     = get_mode(vec),
      variance = var(vec, na.rm = TRUE),
      se       = sd(vec, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_non_na)
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(variable)
}

# ---- Run on your 3 datasets ----
summary_ha10_cs <- summarize_numeric(ha10_cs)
summary_ha10_os <- summarize_numeric(ha10_os)
summary_ha80_cs <- summarize_numeric(ha80_cs)

# View one
summary_ha10_cs

```
